email.subject1: a signal play for True Fit
email.body1:
Chris, saw True Fit launch the agentic AI shopping experience, early access in March and broader release in April.

A rollout that big usually opens more retail accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for True Fit off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for True Fit.

Launching a new agentic product means the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most revenue leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings True Fit needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for True Fit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how True Fit's reply rate likely compares to other retail-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A new product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to True Fit either way.
